subject.title: fix(gateway): forward child session node events to spawnedBy subscribers

question: Should gateway node subscribers receive spawned child-session events through implicit spawnedBy ancestor fanout, or should the fix use explicit child subscription propagation or a child-spawn notification contract instead?
rationale: The PR changes who receives gateway node events, which is a delivery contract choice that code review cannot safely settle without gateway owner intent.

options.title: Adopt ancestor fanout after repair
options.body: Keep the send-time spawnedBy fallback, but remove negative caching, add late-lineage coverage, drop the changelog edit, and refresh the branch before merge.

options.title: Use explicit child routing
options.body: Replace implicit ancestor fanout with spawn-time child subscription propagation or a child-spawn event that lets nodes opt into child sessions.

options.title: Pause this direction
options.body: Leave exact-key node subscriptions unchanged until a gateway owner defines the permanent child-session delivery contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt ancestor fanout after repair
recommendation.body: Keep the send-time spawnedBy fallback, but remove negative caching, add late-lineage coverage, drop the changelog edit, and refresh the branch before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the assignee and branch owner for this specific gateway delivery-contract proposal.
